dedicated.name: Judas's Broken Sword

why_by_stat.Crush: Mainly useful in PVP. Reduces the enemy’s Block Rate 1%-for-1%, making it easier for Judas to land Critical Hits and deal more damage to tanky enemies.
why_by_stat.DMGAmp: Increases all damage dealt by Judas by the given %, making it useful for both general damage and higher PVE scores. Also increases DOT damage.

dedicated.story:
The bodyguard, acting on his father's orders, swung his sword at Judas, who had suddenly bolted upright in class.
Almost as if to openly defy his teacher, Judas easily subdued the bodyguard and shattered his sword like snapping a twig.

"The strong rule over the weak. This is the correct way, is it not, teacher?"

lore:
Though born the second prince of the demonkin as an illegitimate son and possessing overwhelming martial power, Judas was never acknowledged by the royal court and was ultimately exiled to the borderlands.
Witnessing his fellow kin suffering under human oppression, Judas rejected the incompetent royal house and resolved to become the savior of the demonkin.
Declaring all-out war against humanity, he pressed forward, subjugating two key figures along the way: Eve, a young girl who lost her parents after being betrayed by humans, and Bael, a monstrous sorcerer driven mad by hunger.
Judas successfully marched his forces to the steps of the Temple of Nestra, where he clashed with Yeonhee, the Dimensional Keeper.
However, a sealing ritual performed by the alliance of Night Elves and humans tore open a dimensional rift, casting Judas and his lieutenants deep into the Abyss.
Trapped in the dark void for centuries with nothing but thoughts of vengeance, Judas used the rift to have Bael's woven threads connected to Eve. Through these threads, he raised a rift known as the "Black Moon" into the skies above, unleashing swarms of monsters upon the world.
